rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Full sequential read, all 14 chunks. Every pronoun/demonstrative resolves in-chunk or against an earlier chunk of the same file (e.g. chunk 8 line 79 'The other kind' resolves against chunk 7's 'two kinds' split named two lines earlier; chunk 9 'a single subagent' and chunk 10 'a subagent doing your noisy reading' resolve against chunk 4's 'Subagent as a firewall'; chunk 10 'starting clean' resolves against chunk 3's 'Start clean' bold lead). Forward-signposting sentences (chunk 1 line 15 'the rest of this page', chunk 7 line 73 'two kinds... Start with the durable ones') self-define their own category in the same sentence rather than pointing at something that should already be named -- roadmap structure, not an unresolved referent. Closest call: chunk 11 line 99 'write the evals' inside the closing italic aside -- 'the evals' is never defined anywhere in the body. But the maintainer block (line 131, 'Closing italic aside is deliberate... same device-family as story-of-module-6.md... Keep any such figure round, large, self-referential; don't chase precision') frames the whole aside as an impressionistic authorial wink about the page's own writing sessions, not a claim the reader must decode to follow the lesson (which lands regardless: writing this page itself blew its context budget twice). Logged as a TODO, not a REVISE -- see todos.

Only cross-file callback in the body: chunk 4 line 49, 'You'll meet it properly, mechanism and trade-off both, in Module 3.' Independently re-verified the underlying facts: module order confirmed live in site/layouts/curriculum.js (M1 getting-going, M2 plan-mode-done-right, M3 earn-the-trust, M4 run-the-first-experiment); the file's three real inbound links confirmed live (how-instructions-grow.md:48 [M2 close], earn-the-trust.md:106 [M3's own closer, the last line of its ## Next section, AFTER its subagent-use LOs at lines 22-24], run-the-first-experiment.md:12 [M4 prework]) -- matching the maintainer Placement block exactly. This is the identical fact pattern already investigated: this exact rule-2 question was filed as a REVISE against this exact sentence, then adversarially verified and REFUTED, with the row re-stamped PASS (verify-refuted) at pin b55cd28b (recorded in the file's own Quality line and in the prior instance's resolution field, settled=refuted, at=534a5e84). body_sha here is identical to the pin the refutation covers -- the body has not moved. Harm check: rule 2 exists to stop a claim whose truth depends on deck position the reader doesn't share; I re-derived the same underlying tension (the M3-close entry reads 'in Module 3' as the last line of the module it's finishing) that the original finding already argued and that was already reviewed and rejected. Per the dispatch mechanics ('re-file only on fresh evidence against the current body'), I found no evidence beyond what was already adjudicated, so I do not re-file it. No other cross-file positional callback exists elsewhere in the body (the Amp/Handoff and Yegge/Memento references are external citations, not curriculum cross-file pointers).

All 14 chunks carry a self-standing claim, cold. Shortest body chunk, 9 (fanning out, lines 87-89), still states its own thesis in 3 sentences (fan-out is a real but contested, single-source-sourced cost; treat as a ceiling for research-style work, not this training's default) rather than leaning on a wait-state or a bare context-dependent bullet. Corroborated by check-slide-size.js (run this session): 13 slides, none flagged as empty/near-empty.

Checked all 13 `##` headers against their own chunk body. All literally true summaries (e.g. line 61 'The folklore: numbers that don't survive a second look' against the two debunked round-number claims that follow; line 91 'One lever, two payoffs' against its own next sentence 'Token efficiency is one lever with two payoffs'). Closest call: line 45 'The craft: spend and route wisely' against its third move, line 53 'Keep what you carry lean' -- restraint reads slightly off 'spend wisely', but the chunk's own frame sentence ('The rest are about what you do with the work once it's in front of you', line 47) covers routing AND restraint loosely enough that the header still holds. Second closest: line 95 'Now go clean your window' against the meta-aside content that follows it (mostly session-biography, not direct instruction) -- resolves through its own closing line, 101, 'The cheapest context is the one you just let go of', which restates the header's imperative directly. Neither is contradicted by its chunk.

Grepped body for the 'Not X. Not Y.' construction (mechanical: /Not [A-Za-z].*\. Not [A-Za-z]/ over the raw file) -> 0 hits, run this session. Manual per-chunk read for the remaining sub-items: anaphora/epistrophe triples -- none (chunk 11's 'Discipline shrinks the bloat. It does not abolish it.' is a two-sentence pair, not a triple, and not repeating a leading word). Self-grading superlatives -- none target this training/exercise's own value; the one candidate, chunk 3 line 41 'the cheapest quality upgrade there is, and the most skipped', grades the /clear habit in general, not this training's usefulness, so it doesn't match check_writing §13's value-prop-leak target. Number + own retraction -- none; every figure (100K/20K tokens line 28, 23-54% line 9, ~a sixth/~a third line 75, ~$10/~$2/~$1 line 33, 15x line 89) is stated once with its sourcing/caveat attached and used, never stated then hedged into nothing -- the 15x figure's 'but it's a year old, single-source' caveat is evidentiary qualification feeding a stated use ('treat it as a ceiling'), not the self-cancelling number+retraction pattern the rule targets. Abstraction-noun stacks -- none; the page favours concrete phrasing throughout (e.g. 'the files Claude didn't load' register, not 'the bounded-window reality' register). Empty-leg verb triplets -- none.
